content: 6:1-11 Yisas yurau sios munon me wuribubur qereimunor
Aninou yurau erogori end munon ger mindigar qob ger gab eng mai, wo Qenu munon yurau eng wurinipar isub Qenu yurau ue eng wurinob qamb musiaun qamb obounon eng boru.

In Qenu munon yurau, in munon ar gugum wuriqereimboun eng an me imbig igoumon? Git eng apand, munon gugum wurinou qomon eng qereimboumon eng maigas at qereimboumon? Mindigar qob qamaman eng mai aninou qereimunon eng misue qiyo?
In enger wurinou qomon eng gor qereimboun qiyo? Io, enger wurinou qomon eng gor qereimboun. End ne mi ag et qereimoun eng qeemben gari.
End ne an mindigar qob ger igub eng meimet qamb munon Yisas me imbig igour eng qereimar qamb wurinob qamb igoumon?
Ye qob eng at quraum eng an igub qininingar qamb quraum. Maigas, aninou yurau end gari ger igo ger mindigar qob wot qamara gab ne ger der qob musitariner eng qoyam ue qiyo?
Ego an bo munon eng nipat qut bigune munon Yisas me imbig igour eng musitarar qamb ebet igoumon.

Io, an qiagunub qut big igoumon end ye mom animbigoum. Qomon boru qo anmuaseramorei. An munon ger anquguragsia gab eng song qi igamari ende ebeiner. A munon ger an mi urim baia gab eng qi igamari bainer.
Eng, an oau mein wogub ne an yurau gari qas banamori imaori ten igoumon eng nasi wogub qisumungasi qiyo, a mi urim baub qiyo, ende at igoumon.

Munon qomon boru ebet igour eng Qenu wonou bibis end me igorunorei. Qob eng an qoyam ue? Aninou misirt mi gag obounon eng qoyametarar. Munon yamangar irou wurinob qib igo eng, ne ai bigau, sogoin eng gagar wurit igub igo eng, ne yamangar baub wogub bo yamangar qei wurinob qib igo eng, ne munon der wurinou qibaub igour qiyo, mi eng gagar.
Ne gor mi urim ba ne munon ger wonomi wot ba ne ya uter nub qanganget, ne munon ger qob isi wot qamb at igour munon yurau eng Qenu wonou bibis end me irunorei.

Qoan an munon yurau eng gas ende qei igoumon ego yat anmaragansi obotarari ne Qenu wonou anqubeiamorei. Anqubeima ne an munon qoregen buramanei. Ininou Qenu eng Yisas munon inubersiau tari eng gab-gab ne wonou Igomurur qau end inmusiarei.
6:12-20 Ininou git goan e Qenu Igomurur wonou mon

End ne munon qei ete qomorunor eng: “Mi gugum qau ue, ye ar ebeibam,” qomorunor eng git uber eng mi gugum me inmusierinerei. Ye ete qemerin eng: “Mi gugum ye ar ebeibam” qemerin eng uber ego mi ger ye me yoat igoriner.

Ne munon qei ete qomorunor eng: “Mani nioun eng iriamt isub igo, iriam eng mani nub igo,” qomorunor eng, git apand ego Qenu wo mi ombur eng aba uburiba. Git goan eng yamangart at qib igamau ue, git goan eng Qenu wonou, ne Munon Aib eng git goan eng end igo.
Qenu wonou Munon Aib menima igomot der bugamor gas ende in bo inmenima der bugomboun.
Aninou git goan gugum eng Munon inubersiau tari wonou git goan eng anit igo. End ne mai, ye bo wonou git goan eng ba yamangar qarig ir qib igo end big qemerini qiyo? Sig ue.
Munon ger wonou yamangar qarig nob qenen qib igoriner eng ombur git goan gari gas ende. Qomon end ne Qenu qob nausi ete qamarei: “munon yamangar qibaub eng git goan gari qas burubour.”
Ne munon ger Munon Aib mom tenori igo eng wonou Igomurur qau eng nob mom igo.
Yamangar song-song nob qib igamau qomon eng siningot wogub iuar. Qomon boru qei munon ebet igour eng git goan ag ar. Ego yamangar song-song nob qirun eng git goan mom iriget isub borusi igo.
Aninou git goan eng Igomurur qau wonou munai qau end gitetet igoarar. Qenu Igomurur qau imurima der anit isuor end wo an git goan erobon end igo. End ne an git goan eng bo aninou ue.
Qenu mi sig aibt antauiamorei. End ne an qenen aninou git goan eng gugum wot mismisir igoarar.
